Flight controls

F-15 radar: V shows/hides the radar view. Use its range and Search/Track controls; click a contact to select it.

F-15: X fires a missile. Eight rounds; reset reloads. T selects an opposing aircraft. Aim toward it to lock; missiles use simplified game homing.

G: gear · [ / ]: flaps · B: brakes · P: parking brake · A/D: ground steering.

F toggles full screen. Press Esc to exit.

Hold a key to deflect the controls. Release to return to the trimmed position.
